subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Rosy Retrospection
description: A micro-lesson that makes Rosy Retrospection usable.

hook.text: Your college years feel magical in memory. Your diary from that time tells a different story.

buildup.text: Mitchell found that vacationers rated trips more positively in memory than they did during the trip.

discovery.text: Rosy retrospection: we recall past events more favorably than we experienced them at the time.

twist.text: The brain edits out boredom, discomfort, and frustration. The highlight reel replaces the full film.

climax.text: Nostalgia isn't accurate. It's your brain's edited greatest-hits album of the past.

punchline.text: The good old days weren't that good.

quiz.question: What does rosy retrospection cause?
options: We recall past events more positively than they were
We remember the worst parts more vividly
